How Widgets Are Made

Widgets begin life as raw alloy ingots, which are melted down at temperatures exceeding one thousand degrees before being poured into precision moulds designed by our engineering team over several years.

After cooling, each widget is inspected by hand for surface defects. Those that pass move on to the polishing line, where a sequence of progressively finer abrasives brings out the characteristic shine.

Quality control

Every batch is sampled and tested for tensile strength, corrosion resistance, and weight tolerance before it is allowed to ship to customers around the world.
